glosses: Any elderly woman, regardless of if she has grandchildren.

examples.text: That granny over there needs your assistance.

glosses: An older ewe that may lure a lamb away from its mother.

examples.text: The suitcase was old. The brown leather was battered and scuffed. Two hanks of clothesline had been wrapped around it and tied in large, clownish grannies.

glosses: Typically or stereotypically old-fashioned, especially in clothing and accessories worn by or associated with elderly women.

examples.text: Бабушка, или, как её называли в доме, бабуля, очень полная, некрасивая, с густыми бровями и с усиками, говорила громко, и уже по её голосу и манере говорить было заметно, что она здесь старшая в доме.
